finding: A keyless tools/list sent with NO mcp-session-id header answered HTTP 200 with the full tool list on 2026-09-30, so the session identifier the server mints at initialize is not required to call it. The endpoint serves exactly three tools, microsoft_docs_search, microsoft_code_sample_search and microsoft_docs_fetch, each annotated readOnlyHint true, idempotentHint true and destructiveHint false, and the server's own instructions string and the vendor's README table name the same three. One asymmetry in this response matters later: microsoft_docs_search declares no required array and gives query a "default": null, while its sibling microsoft_code_sample_search requires the same query field.
